newsitem.title: USA: Metatec sees Q4 EPS below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Metatec sees Q4 EPS below expectations.

text.p: Metatec Corp said Monday that its fourth quarter earnings will be below analysts' expectations, which ranged between $0.11 and $0.13.
The company said it expects sales for the quarter will also be below analysts' expectations and up only slightly over the $11.9 million in sales for the 1995 fourth quarter.
The company attributed lower-than-expected results to a shortfall in sales from our its New Media Solutions Group and slower growth in its Manufacturing Services Group.
The company said it would release its results February 6.
